name: clef-verify
description: Before Claude ends a turn that changed files, has Cloudflare's Clairic extraction model (or the Clef decision model) check that the work is shown to be done (tests run and passing where needed, claims backed by the steps, nothing asked for left undone), and sends Claude back if not.

accountId.title: Cloudflare Account ID
accountId.description: The account whose Workers AI runs Clairic or Clef. Falls back to the CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID environment variable.

apiToken.title: Cloudflare API Token
apiToken.description: A token with Workers AI read permission, kept in secure storage. Falls back to the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN environment variable.

model.title: Model
model.description: clairic (extracts the test counts, failures and unbacked claims, and quotes them when sending Claude back), clef (27B, most accurate), clef-flash (9B, fastest and cheapest) or clef-omni (30B mixture-of-experts).

threshold.title: Send-back threshold
threshold.description: Send Claude back when the model is at least this sure (0 to 1) that something is missing.

maxRetries.title: Most send-backs per prompt
maxRetries.description: How many times Claude can be sent back for one of your prompts; after that the turn ends and a toast says what the model still found missing.
